title: Fabrication of blue emissive carbon dots using Morinda citrifolia fruit pulp for clodinafop and cypermethrin detection via fluorescence turn-off and enhancement mechanisms

Morinda citrifolia fruit pulp was introduced as a green source for the fabrication of fluorescent CDs for sensing of clodinafop and cypermethrin in water, soil and vegetables.
